final:
config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  ex config_value("port=8080\nhost=localhost", "port") == "8080"
  ex config_value("port=8080\nhost=localhost", "missing") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    if parts.len() >= 2
      if parts[0] == key
        if parts.len() == 2
          return copy parts[1]
        var val = copy parts[1]
        for i in range(2, parts.len())
          val = "\(val)=\(parts[i])"
        return val
  ""

test_config_value() =
  assert config_value("port=8080\nhost=localhost", "port") == "8080"
  assert config_value("port=8080\nhost=localhost", "host") == "localhost"
  assert config_value("port=8080\nhost=localhost", "missing") == ""
  assert config_value("url=http://example.com?a=1&b=2", "url") == "http://example.com?a=1&b=2"
